name: agentic-commerce
description: Razorpay Buildathon — Track 1 (Agentic Commerce). A Claude-powered shopping agent with human-in-the-loop payment authorization and a real-time explainable audit trail. Monorepo: backend (Express + SQLite + Claude tool-calling + Razorpay Sandbox) and frontend (React 18 + Tailwind v4).

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.demo: npm run build && npm run start
